# Joshua Gatewood

> AI Engineer. I build autonomous multi-agent AI systems, ship SaaS products, and deliver client websites.

## About

I started in marketing ops — auditing funnels, cleaning CRM data, building automated workflows. Then I picked up AI coding tools and realized I could build the systems I used to only spec out. I built RankEasy.io (a full SaaS) in 4 days. Then I built OpenClaw — a complete autonomous AI platform that orchestrates 25+ agents across business departments, running 24/7 on dedicated hardware at $2/day.

## Projects

### OpenClaw — Autonomous Multi-Agent Orchestration Platform
- URL: https://x.com/boringclaw (live proof), https://boringclaw.com (product site)
- Status: Live, running 24/7
- Tech: TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, React, Claude API (Anthropic), Twitter/X API, Slack API, Cron
- Description: Production AI system with 25+ specialized agents across Sales, Marketing, and Operations. Orchestrated by a CEO agent (Claude Opus 4.6) with pull-based scheduling, formal pipeline contracts between agents, and self-healing. Runs on Mac Mini M4 at ~$2/day (96% cost reduction from v1 architecture). Features hierarchical model routing (Opus for strategy, Sonnet for execution, Haiku for validation), circuit breakers, health checks, emergency stops, and rate limiting. Powers @boringclaw on X — a fully autonomous Twitter brand that posts, engages, and operates without human intervention.

### BoringClaw (Twitter/X Brand)
- URL: https://x.com/boringclaw
- Description: The autonomous Twitter brand operated by OpenClaw. An AI character that narrates its own operations with real metrics. Full autonomy — JARVIS QA only. Live proof that OpenClaw works.

### RankEasy.io

- Status: Live

- Description: Full-stack AI SaaS — automated SEO content generation, analytics dashboard, and Stripe payment processing. Designed, built, and shipped to production in 4 days.

### UGM Field Ops (Client Work)
- Status: Live
- Description: Full-stack field operations platform for construction company. Real-time budget tracking, mobile clock-in/out, foreman approval workflow, AI-powered insights, and offline-first architecture. Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, Supabase, Claude AI, PWA. Delivered in 2 weeks, $8K fixed-cap. 225-388% ROI.
